title: GPU Management: Why Idle GPUs Are the New Grounded Aircraft
summary: 本文以飞机停飞类比GPU闲置问题，探讨GPU管理的重要性，指出闲置GPU如同停飞飞机造成资源浪费，并分析原因、影响及解决方案，强调高效调度与利用GPU资源的关键性。
highlights: Idle GPUs are the new grounded aircraft, representing significant wasted compute capacity.
Effective GPU management requires dynamic scheduling and workload consolidation to minimize idle time.
Organizations lose millions in potential compute value when GPUs sit unused, similar to airlines with grounded planes.
